title: Instrument the DODGE-013 warm-start control-rate comparison
doing: Prepare a separately owned K1-versus-K4 diagnostic successor from420. Require per-update KL and epoch KL/stop information, entropy, value loss, raw advantage/return/reward scales and valid within-episode action-switch counts/rates for both arms. Freeze telemetry definitions and test passive integration without training; any diagnostic campaign requires its own registration, review, resource qualification and explicit go-ahead. Proposed B0 is two control-rate arms x two training seeds,1179648rawframes per trajectory; no efficacy evaluation or fresh cohort in this short diagnostic.
expected: If the warm-start regression involves optimization or value/credit scaling, the K1 arm may diverge in KL/entropy/value/advantage trajectories before survival regresses. If those remain comparable, local planning, state distribution and representation remain candidates. Telemetry associations alone cannot identify a cause.
actual: Prepared a passive per-update telemetry adapter and strict two-arm update-coverage validator. Twelve CPU synthetic integration tests pass, including raw GAE scale, valid action-switch denominators across rollouts/resets, hook restoration, first-failure preservation and missing-row rejection; no native games, model restores or real optimizer steps ran. A retrospective read of accepted DODGE-013 rows found0/181 K4 and0/180 K1 KL early-stop flags, with all361 updates completing four epochs; numerical KL remains unrecorded. This is historical receipt analysis, not successor execution.
next_step: Freeze/review a separately registered bounded diagnostic runner with this integration and real guard/restore/metric parity checks. Await Taylor go-ahead before any launch.
